usage.notes: SATUSEHAT is a live national interoperability service. Panacea uses server-side OAuth client-credentials and the official FHIR R4 endpoints; browser code must never receive the client secret. Without configured credentials the current adapter only builds a local preview Bundle and performs no SATUSEHAT network I/O.

license.scope: Official SATUSEHAT Platform API access, documentation and exchanged healthcare data. Public documentation confirms access requirements and credential handling but does not establish one blanket open-content or commercial redistribution licence for all API data/resources.
license.notes: Production credentials are issued to verified interoperability partners and must remain confidential. Do not infer permission to redistribute patient, terminology or other third-party content merely because it is exchanged through SATUSEHAT. Re-check current partner, privacy, retention and data-use obligations before production activation.

validation.notes: SATUSEHAT provides a regulated interoperability pathway, not independent validation that Panacea-generated clinical content is correct. FHIR conformance, IHS/NIK identity reconciliation, organization/practitioner/location identifiers, terminology binding and workflow-specific certification remain separate requirements before real clinical submission.

provenance.authority: Kementerian Kesehatan Republik Indonesia — SATUSEHAT Platform
provenance.notes: Preserve SATUSEHAT environment (sandbox or production), FHIR R4 endpoint generation, returned resource id/meta/version where available, Organization/IHS identities and the local source record used to construct each outbound Bundle. Never treat a local preview Bundle as proof that SATUSEHAT accepted or validated it.

adapter.notes: Current adapter centralizes OAuth token handling, server-side secret isolation, path validation, bounded network timeouts and deterministic FHIR Bundle construction. Production activation must remain fail-closed until SATUSEHAT credentials and required national identity mappings are configured and verified.

trust.notes: High authority as Indonesia's national health interoperability platform. The service is not itself biomedical evidence, and licence/data-use scope is deliberately scored conservatively until production partner terms are reviewed for the exact Panacea use case.
